description: Larissa Waters resigns as leader of the Greens; David Shoebridge is elected leader
The 2026 federal budget is presented by Treasurer Jim Chalmers
David Littleproud resigns as leader of the National Party; Matt Canavan is elected leader
The Strait of Hormuz is closed as part of the Iran war, triggering a fuel crisis in Australia
Angus Taylor becomes leader of the Opposition after defeating Sussan Ley in a leadership spill
Barnaby Joyce resigns from the Nationals to sit as an independent
The first dissolution of the Liberal–National Coalition
Sussan Ley elected as Leader of the Liberal Party and the Opposition, replacing Peter Dutton
